verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail is a cloud email client, so data residency and region selection is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to choose a storage region or residency. One community comment notes only that emails are stored on Superhuman's servers, which says nothing about letting the user pick where.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
